| # Object 0x100A manufacturer software version {#object-0x100a-manufacturer-software-version-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains the device software version.

 

  Index           0x100A
  --------------- -------------------------------------
  Name            Manufacturer Software Version
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       Visible String
  Category        Optional
  Access          Const
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     No
  Default Value   Version of BODAS BSW of the device.

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   By default, it contains the version of BODAS BSW of the device.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------
